name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 10 – Am 47
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 10a. Considers that a strategy to combat poverty with a view to its eradication depends, among other things, on adequate funding, requiring mobilisation of the EU budget; calls for the creation, within the European Social Fund+, of a specific funding line for poverty eradication in the 2027 budget; considers that this specific funding for poverty eradication is without prejudice to the mobilisation of resources from other funds or programmes aimed at objectives directly or indirectly related to poverty, in particular in the areas of housing, child and youth protection, migration, and combating inequalities and discrimination;
